title: Amazon SQS to AWS Batch job queue using Amazon EventBridge Pipes
description: This pattern uses SQS and triggers AWS Batch job queue directly with optional filtering supported.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: SQS queue is polled and messages are sent to AWS Batch job queue. SQS messages are filtered before reaching AWS Batch job queue, and custom events in AWS Batch jobs are raised.
See the README in the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

authors.name: Sayan Moitra
authors.bio: Sayan is a Solutions Architect working with Amazon Web Services.
